message.reasoning_content:
We need to determine the crime(s) based on facts. The fact: defendant knowingly has obligation to fulfill a civil judgment, but during execution he intentionally hides assets, causing the judgment to be unenforceable. This is typical "拒不执行判决、裁定罪" (refusal to execute judgment). In Chinese criminal law, article 311 (formerly 311) is "拒不执行判决、裁定罪". The crime is "拒不执行判决、裁定罪". In examples, they often label as "拒不执行判决、裁定". So answer: [罪名]拒不执行判决、裁定<eoa>. Possibly also "隐匿财产" but that's part of same crime. So final answer.
